mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS security_user ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, roles VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_security_user_user_id (user_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_security_user_username (username), KEY idx_security_user_status (status) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, password_hash, roles, status, created_at, updated_at FROM security_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
